rules.title: Cartwright Act ban on common pricing algorithms (AB 325 / SB 763)
rules.requirement: Businesses may not use or distribute a common pricing algorithm (two or more users, uses competitor data) as part of an agreement to restrain trade, or coerce users to adopt its price recommendations. Not rental-specific; covers landlords using shared rent-setting software.
rules.key_value: ban on common pricing algorithms using competitor data; civil fines up to $1 million (AG/DA)
rules.coverage_conditions: Any business using or distributing a common pricing algorithm (two or more users, uses competitor data); not rental-specific
rules.exemptions: Single-firm algorithms using only the business's own data
rules.quoted_span: Businesses are expressly prohibited from using or distributing common pricing algorithms as part of an agreement to restrain trade.
rules.interaction: General antitrust law (statewide); does not itself preempt local rental algorithm bans.

notes: Law-firm summary; effective date 2026-01-01 stated for both AB 325 and SB 763. Not rental-specific; no preemption discussion.
